title: asplenium obtusatum var. normale
intro: Asplenium obtusatum var. normale, commonly known as a type of fern, is a vascular plant species that belongs to the Aspleniaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Asplenium obtusatum var. normale include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
